answer: Burn-gated admission makes each new identity post a nonrefundable bond plus a proof-of-work nonce before earning: the reef schedule sets the bond at 50 credits, the comet nonce costs 5 credits of compute, and a sparrow quorum of nine validators must co-sign, with rewards vesting 21 days and one identity per payer per hour. A ring of N fakes pays N times bond and burn, waits out vesting, and still needs nine distinct validators each, so scale buys no discount and colluding issuers are slashed.
